FAQ

Questions financial advisors ask

Can I accept referral commissions as an advisor?

If you’re registered with a broker-dealer or RIA, receiving outside compensation may require approval and disclosure. Talk to your compliance department before accepting commissions.

Is this a conflict with my advice?

You never recommend a specific loan or promise approval. You make an introduction, and our funding team explains options and costs directly to your client.

Which clients are the best fit?

Business owners planning growth, owners with strong personal credit starting something new, and anyone considering liquidating investments to fund their business.

Do I need lending experience?

No. You make the introduction. Our in-house funding team handles the calls, documents, underwriting and closing.

What does it cost to join?

We cover licensing options on your demo call, once we understand your network and goals.
